Ali Şenol’s arXiv preprint reports that its prompt-only Chain-of-Self-Questioning method cut wrong commitments from 13.1% to 8.9% and raised answered accuracy from 86.9% to 89.7% across 11 model families on 817 TruthfulQA questions.
The same evaluation sent 12.3% of questions to abstention and added three model calls, so the result is a measured risk–coverage trade-off rather than a universal accuracy claim.
